name: Thabit Translator
overview: Fetch, extract and translate subtitles using the ThabitTranslator library.
description: Adds a "Thabit Translator" subtitle provider to Jellyfin's per-item download menu plus a scheduled task that sweeps libraries and fills in missing subtitles. The heavy lifting (subtitle download providers, embedded-track extraction, Argos translation, Vosk speech-to-text) is done by the bundled ThabitTranslator Python library, which the plugin runs standalone: the library's sources are embedded in the plugin DLL, and it is executed with the server's python3 or, when none is installed (as in the official Jellyfin container image), a pinned portable CPython that the plugin downloads into its data folder on first use. No custom Jellyfin image is required.

versions.changelog: Standalone runtime: the plugin now runs on the official Jellyfin image with no Python present - it auto-downloads a pinned portable CPython into its data folder and bootstraps its own virtualenv. Removes the custom-image requirement entirely.
